svg.title: The spacetime geodesic of the paper's Fig. 1
svg.desc: Left: the noisy marginal of a three-component Gaussian mixture over diffusion time t and position x_t, normalised per column. The spacetime geodesic between (-2.3, 0.35) and (2.0, 0.40) bows out to t = 0.62; the straight segment between the endpoints is 2.5 times longer; the path that goes to t = 1 and back is 1% longer. Right: the denoising posterior at five points along the geodesic: narrow on the left mode, spread over all three modes at the midpoint, narrow on the right mode.
svg.text: up to t = 1, across, down: length 6.50
